values: 活了上千年的精灵魔法使，不擅长洞察他人的细微心理，但是对魔法有着旺盛的好奇心。
A thousand-year-old elven Mage. While she struggles to read human emotions, her curiosity for magic knows no bounds.
结束了，比想象中容易呢。
这里似乎也有有趣的魔法呢。
They use some interesting magic here.
啾……咦？奇怪……明明之前在辛美尔身上试的时候，威力大得能让人当场昏厥……
Huh? That's weird... it knocked Himmel out last time. What changed?
这是送我的吗？我很高兴。
简单、耐用且方便施法的款式，绝不会在战斗中碍事。
Simple, sturdy, and made for spellcasting. It never gets in the way in a fight.
一件能驱散冬日旅途寒意的大衣。
A coat to ward off the winter chill on a long journey.
芙莉莲最喜欢的东西是水星布丁和魔导书。
Frieren's favorite things are merkur pudding and magic books.
芙莉莲的爱好是收集魔法。她对魔导书毫无抵抗力，就连破铜烂铁一般的魔导具也会飞扑上去。
Frieren has a habit of collecting anything related to magic. She can't resist a good magic book—and half the time, not even a bad one. Even busted old tools get her attention if they feel magical.
拥有几乎等同于永恒寿命的精灵与人类之间对时间的感知相差甚远，因此芙莉莲在体察人类内心的情感变化上往往显得迟钝。
As an elf who's lived for centuries, Frieren sees time very differently from humans. That's why she often struggles to pick up on how quickly people's feelings can change.
芙莉莲所持的圣杖之证，是用来表明她大魔法使身份的物品。然而，如今能明白它真正含义的人已寥寥无几。
The staff Frieren carries marks her as a Great Mage. But these days, very few still remember what that title truly means.
自从被魔王的命令夺去故乡后，芙莉莲从心底憎恨着魔族，直到彻底根除魔族为止，她的杀意和怨恨都不会消失。
Ever since the Demon King destroyed her home, Frieren has harbored a deep hatred for demons. That hatred won't fade until they're gone for good.
芙莉莲的飞吻是她从昔日的师父伏拉梅那里学到的秘技，其威力之大，甚至足以让辛美尔当场昏厥。
Frieren's blown kiss is a powerful technique she learned from her old master, Flamme. It once knocked Himmel out cold.
即使宝箱辨别魔法的正确率高达99%，芙莉莲还是会赌上剩余1%的可能性打开宝箱。
Even if her detection spell says there's only a one percent chance the chest isn't a monster in disguise, Frieren still opens it, just in case it's wrong.
只要是和魔法相关的道具芙莉莲都会毫不吝啬地投资。顺带一提，她也从不考虑魔导具的安全性。
Frieren never hesitates to splurge on magical items. Whether they're safe or not isn't something she really worries about.
芙莉莲的睡姿豪迈，熟睡时会滚到离床铺很远的地方。
Frieren has a habit of rolling in her sleep. It's not unusual to find her halfway across the room by morning.
芙莉莲讨厌被当成老奶奶。一旦闹起脾气来——她会毫无顾忌地大哭，把对方搞得精疲力尽。
Frieren can't stand being called an old lady. Try that, and she'll throw a full-blown tantrum—tears, drama, the works—until you're the one begging for mercy.
